en.title: Disney's Worldbuilders Doc Reveals Secrets Behind Iconic Lands
en.summary: A new Disney+ documentary dives deep into the creation of beloved theme park worlds. Featuring insights from industry titans like James Cameron and Kevin Feige, it promises a behind-the-scenes look fans won't want to miss.
en.body:
The magic behind Disney's most enchanting theme park lands is about to be unveiled. **Leslie Iwerks**’ highly anticipated documentary, **‘Disney Worldbuilders’**, is set to premiere on Disney+ next month, offering an exclusive glimpse into the meticulous process of transforming beloved stories into breathtaking real-world attractions. This film goes beyond the rides and shows, exploring the creative minds and innovative techniques that bring franchises like *Frozen* and *Zootopia* to life for millions of visitors.

Directed by Iwerks, granddaughter of Disney Legend **Ub Iwerks**, the documentary taps into the deep well of Disney's creative heritage. It features interviews with some of the most influential figures in modern entertainment, including **James Cameron**, **Kevin Feige**, and **Jon Favreau**. These storytellers, known for crafting some of the biggest cinematic universes, will peel back the curtain on how they conceptualized and collaborated to translate iconic screen narratives into the immersive environments fans cherish. The film promises to showcase rare archival footage and recordings, providing an unparalleled look at the dedication and artistry involved in Disney's park development.

## Crafting Immersive Fantasies

**‘Disney Worldbuilders’** isn't just about nostalgia; it’s a testament to the power of storytelling and the ambition to create environments that captivate audiences long after the credits roll. From the intricate details that evoke a sense of wonder to the complex engineering that makes the impossible possible, the documentary aims to demystify the creation of these unforgettable destinations. The film highlights how Disney’s approach to theme park design is intrinsically linked to its storytelling prowess, ensuring that each visit feels like stepping directly into a cherished narrative.

> "Go behind-the-scenes with iconic storytellers in the new documentary, 'Disney Worldbuilders'. The doc is directed by Leslie Iwerks... Kevin Feige, Jon Favreau, James Cameron and more peel back the curtain on how some of Disney's legendary worlds are created in a new documentary."

## A Dream for Fans and Imagineers

For dedicated fans and aspiring creators alike, **‘Disney Worldbuilders’** offers a unique opportunity to understand the collaborative spirit and visionary thinking that defines the Disney experience. It underscores the profound connection between film, television, and the physical spaces that extend these narratives. The anticipation for this documentary is palpable, as it promises to be an inspiring exploration of how dreams are brought to life, providing a deeper appreciation for the parks that have become synonymous with magic and imagination for generations. It’s a celebration of the enduring power of Disney’s creative legacy.

## What's Next

**‘Disney Worldbuilders’** is scheduled to premiere at D23 on August 16, 2026, before becoming available on Disney+ in August 2026. Further details regarding specific streaming times and potential bonus content are expected closer to the release date.
